name: Kinzan market quake archive
description: Every day a tracked currency, coin, stock, index, commodity or bond moved three or more standard deviations of its own recent volatility, measured close to close against the previous 20 daily returns. Recorded the night after the day settled and never rewritten.

columns.name: key
columns.description: Unique id of the quake: {date}-{slug}. The last path segment of its record page.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Day the move ENDED on (YYYY-MM-DD, the instrument's own daily close).

columns.name: prev_date
columns.description: Day of the previous close the move is measured from. Spans weekends and holidays: Friday to Monday is one move.

columns.name: ticker
columns.description: Short label Kinzan uses for it.

columns.name: class
columns.description: Asset class: forex, metal, crypto, commodity, index, rate or stock.

columns.name: group
columns.description: Kinzan's group within the class, or empty.

columns.name: sigma
columns.description: Size of the move in standard deviations of the instrument's own previous 20 daily returns (sample SD), signed, one decimal. A quake is |sigma| >= 3.

columns.name: return_pct
columns.description: Close-to-close percentage move on the day, signed, two decimals.

columns.name: vol20_pct
columns.description: The 20-day volatility the move was measured against, in percent: |return_pct / sigma|.

columns.name: beats
columns.description: Consecutive measured sessions before this one that were smaller, walking back through the window available when it was recorded.

columns.name: larger_since
columns.description: Date of the last larger move found in that window, or empty when the move was larger than every session in it.

columns.name: measured
columns.description: How many Kinzan instruments had a measurable move that day.

columns.name: stressed
columns.description: How many of those moved 2 sigma or more that day: the breadth of the shock.

columns.name: url
columns.description: Permanent record page for this quake on kinzan.io.

columns.name: instrument_url
columns.description: The instrument's live page on kinzan.io.
